Here’s a clear, from‑scratch, integrated 12‑week plan that combines strength, cardio, mobility/recovery, and nutrition. It builds from control to heavier strength and ski‑specific capacity while respecting: no jumping, no deep knee flexion under load, pain ≤2/10, no next‑day swelling. Full gym available.

Weekly rhythm (all 12 weeks)
- Strength: 3 days/week (A, B, C), 45–75 minutes.
- Cardio: 2 days/week (seated/low‑impact) with structured progressions.
- Mobility/Recovery: daily micro‑care 8–12 min; mobility circuits 3–4x/week; post‑training cooldown 10–15 min.
- Nutrition: weight maintenance with performance fueling (see end).

Warm‑up every strength day (10–12 min)
- 3–5 min easy bike.
- Dynamic: glute bridge x10, clamshell x12/side, ankle rocks x10, hip airplanes supported x5/side, bodyweight box squat to session’s height x8 (3–1–2 tempo).
- Readiness isos: wall sit at 45–60° x 20–30 s; quad set x10 x 3–5 s.

Key guardrails and cues
- Keep loaded knee flexion mostly 0–70°; expand only if symptom‑free.
- Tempos control joint stress: most squats 3–1–1 to start; use slow eccentrics where noted.
- Progress load 2.5–5% when all sets finish with 1–3 RIR and zero symptoms.

PHASE 1: Weeks 1–3 — Foundation and motor control
Goal: Tolerance to patterns, controlled ROM, isometric strength.

Week 1
A
- Box squat (high): 4x6, 3–1–2
- Trap‑bar RDL (high handles): 4x6
- Leg press (0–70°): 3x8
- Spanish squat iso: 3x20–30 s
- Side plank: 3x25–35 s/side
- Standing calf raise: 3x12

B
- Split squat to high pads, supported: 3x6/side
- Hip thrust: 4x8
- Seated hamstring curl: 3x10
- Band/cable TKE: 3x12–15 (2 s hold)
- Pallof press: 3x10/side
- Tibialis raises: 3x12–15

C
- Belt squat or landmine squat to box: 4x6
- Single‑leg leg press (short ROM): 3x8/side
- 45° back extension: 3x10
- Wall sit: 3x20–30 s
- Suitcase carry: 3x30–40 m/side

Cardio (2x): 30–35 min Zone 2 seated bike; optional 3 x 8 min easy blocks.

Week 2
- Keep exercises; add 1 set to primary squats/hinges or +5–10° ROM if symptom‑free.
- Spanish squat iso 3x30–40 s; add banded side steps 2x12/side.
Cardio: 30–40 min Z2; cadence 80–95 rpm.

Week 3
- Slight load bump; emphasize eccentrics (box squat 4 s down; leg press 3 s down).
- Add lateral control: cable hip abduction 2x12/side; modified Copenhagen 2x15–20 s/side.
Cardio: 1 Z2 35–40 min + 1 intro tempo 3x5 min @ RPE 6–7 (2 min easy).

PHASE 2: Weeks 4–6 — Strength building with higher volume
Goal: More load and sets, introduce supported unilateral/lateral patterns; stay mid‑range.

Week 4
A: Safety bar box squat 5x5; RDL 5x6; Leg press 4x10; Spanish squat 3x40 s; side plank + abduction 3x30 s; seated calves 3x12–15.
B: RFESS to pads 5x6/side; Hip thrust 5x6–8; Ham curl 4x10; TKE 3x15–20; Pallof walkouts 3x6 steps/side; Tib raises 3x15.
C: Belt squat 5x5; SL leg press 4x8–10/side; Back extension 4x10–12; Wall sit 3x40–50 s; Suitcase carry 4x30–40 m.
Cardio: 5x5 min @ RPE 7–8 (2 min easy); 3x10 min @ RPE 6–7 at 95–105 rpm.

Week 5
A: SSB box squat 6x4; RDL 5x5; Leg press 5x8–10; Spanish squat 3x50–60 s; Copenhagen (short lever) 3x20–25 s; standing calves 4x10–12.
B: RFESS 5x6–7/side; Hip thrust 5x6; Ham curl 4x8–10 heavy; Lateral step‑down 4x6/side; Pallof to overhead 3x8/side; Tib raises 3x15–20.
C: Belt squat 6x4; SL leg press 4x10/side; Reverse hyper or good morning 3x8–10; Wall sit cluster 3x(25 s + 10 s + 25 s); Farmer carry 4x30–40 m.
Cardio: Over‑unders 4x8 min (1 min RPE 8 / 1 min RPE 6–7); 30/30s 3 sets of 10 x 30 s hard/30 s easy.

Week 6
A: SSB box squat 6x5; RDL 5x5; Leg press 5x10; Spanish squat 2x60–75 s; Copenhagen 3x25–30 s; calves standing 4x12 + seated 3x12.
B: RFESS 6x5/side; Hip thrust 6x5; Ham curl 4x8 heavy + 1x12 back‑off; Lateral step‑down 4x6–8/side; Anti‑rotation walkouts 3x7 steps/side; Tib raises 3x15–20.
C: Belt squat 6x4; SL leg press 5x8–10/side; Back extension 4x12 (2 s hold); Wall sit 3x60 s; Loaded carries: suitcase + front rack, 3x30–40 m each.
Cardio: 2x12–15 min @ RPE 7–8; 30‑min fartlek alternating 3 min 95–100 rpm / 3 min 80–85 rpm @ RPE 6–7.

PHASE 3: Weeks 7–9 — Heavier strength and force tolerance
Goal: Peak mid‑range strength, stable single‑leg patterns, controlled eccentrics; no impact.

Week 7
A: SSB box squat 6x4 heavy; RDL 5x4–5; Leg press 5x8 heavy; Split‑stance Spanish squat 3x45–60 s/side; Copenhagen 3x25–30 s/side.
B: RFESS 6x4–5/side; Hip thrust 6x4–5; Ham curl 4x8 + 1x12 back‑off; Lateral step‑down 4x6–8/side; Half‑kneeling chop 3x10/side; Calves standing 4x10, seated 3x12.
C: Belt squat 6x4; SL leg press 5x8/side; Good morning 3x6–8 or reverse hyper 3x10–12; Wall sit cluster 3x(30 s + 10 s + 30 s); Farmer carry 4x30–40 m.
Cardio: 30/30s 4 sets of 10 reps; Tempo ladder 6/5/4/3/2 @ RPE 7 (2 min easy).

Week 8
A: SSB box squat 7x3; RDL 5x4 heavy; Leg press 4x10 heavy + 1x15 back‑off; Split‑stance Spanish squat 3x60 s/side.
B: RFESS 6x4/side (heavier if clean); Hip thrust 5x4 heavy + 1x8 back‑off; Ham curl 4x8–10; Slow eccentric step‑downs 4x6/side (3 s down); Anti‑rotation press to OH 3x8–10/side; Calves standing 5x10; seated 3x12–15.
C: Belt squat 6x3–4; SL leg press 5x8–10/side; Back extension 4x12 (2 s hold); Wall sit 3x60–75 s; Carries: front rack 3x30 m + suitcase 3x30 m/side.
Cardio: Over‑unders 3x12 min (1 min RPE 8 / 2 min RPE 6–7); Threshold 6x5 min @ RPE 7–8 (2 min easy).

Week 9 — Peak Strength I (intensity up, volume moderate)
A: SSB box squat 5x3 @ ~82–87% e1RM; RDL 4x4 heavy; Leg press 4x6–8; Split‑stance Spanish squat 3x45–60 s/side; Copenhagen 3x25–30 s/side; Standing calves 4x10.
B: RFESS 5x4/side heavy; Hip thrust 5x3–4 heavy; Ham curl 3x6–8 + 1x12 back‑off; Lateral step‑down 3x6/side; Chop 3x10/side.
C: Belt squat 5x3 heavy; SL leg press 4x8/side; Back extension 3x10; Wall sit 3x60 s; Farmer carry 4x30–40 m.
Cardio: 30/30s advanced 4x12 reps; Threshold 2x15 min @ RPE 7–8.

PHASE 4: Weeks 10–12 — Peak II, consolidate, taper (ski‑specific)
Goal: Feel strongest by Week 12; keep knee quiet.

Week 10 — Peak Strength II
A: SSB box squat 6x2–3 @ 85–90%; RDL 4x3–4; Leg press 3x6–8; Spanish squat 2x60–75 s.
B: RFESS 5x3–4/side; Hip thrust 6x2–3 cluster (45–60 s between mini‑sets); Ham curl 3x6–8; Lateral step‑down 3x6/side; Calves standing 4x8–10 + seated 3x10–12.
C: Belt squat 6x2–3; SL leg press 3x8/side; Back extension 3x8–10; Wall sit cluster 2x(30 s + 10 s + 30 s).
Cardio: Over‑unders long 3x12 min (1 min over/2 min under); High‑cadence endurance 3x12 min @ RPE 6–7.

Week 11 — Consolidate strength, overreach endurance
A: SSB box squat 4x4 @ ~75–80% of W10; RDL 3x4; Leg press density 4x10 (60–75 s rest); Spanish squat 2x75–90 s; Copenhagen 3x30 s/side.
B: RFESS 4x5/side moderate; Hip thrust 4x4; Slow eccentric step‑downs 3x6–8/side; Ham curl 3x8–10; Calves 4x10 + Tib raises 3x15.
C: Belt squat 4x3–4 @ ~80% of W10; SL leg press 3x10/side; Back extension 3x10–12; Ski‑sit 3x60–75 s; Suitcase carries 3x30–40 m/side.
Cardio: 1 x 20 min + 1 x 10–12 min @ RPE 7–8; 40–45 min continuous Z2–Z3 blend with cadence changes.

Week 12 — Taper and freshness
A: SSB box squat 3x3 @ ~80–85% of W10; RDL 3x3; Spanish squat 2x60 s.
B: RFESS 3x3–4/side; Hip thrust 3x3 fast concentric; Lateral step‑down 2x6/side.
C: Belt squat 3x2–3 @ ~80% of W10; SL leg press 2x8/side; Wall sit 2x45–60 s; Light carries 2x30 m.
Cardio: Primer 3x3 min @ RPE 7 (3 min easy); Easy spin 25–35 min Z2 with 2–3 x 10 s fast spins.

Cardio guardrails and engagement (all weeks)
- Stay seated, cadence 85–100 rpm for hard work; avoid standing climbs.
- If knee annoyed: raise saddle, lower resistance, switch to pool/elliptical (if symptom‑free) that day.

Recovery and mobility (condensed)
- Daily micro‑care (8–12 min): quad sets 2x10 (5 s), TKE 2x12–15 (2 s hold), heel slides 2x10, ankle pumps 1–2 min, 2 min diaphragmatic breathing.
- Mobility circuits 3–4x/week (15–20 min): ankle rocks 2x10/side + calf stretches; hip flexor 2x30–45 s/side; 90/90 rotations 2x6/side; adductor rock‑backs 2x8–10/side; figure‑4 glute 2x30–45 s/side; thoracic open‑books 2x6–8/side; modified Copenhagen iso 2x15–25 s/side.
- Post‑training cooldown (10–15 min): 5 min easy spin, light foam roll (quads/adductors/calves/glutes), heel slides 2x10–15, ankle rocks 1x10/side. Ice/elevate 10–15 min if swelling.

Nutrition (weight maintenance, performance‑oriented)
- Calories: start 14–16 kcal/lb (31–35 kcal/kg); adjust ±150–200 kcal after 10–14 days to keep weight within ±0.25%/week.
- Protein: 0.7–1.0 g/lb (1.6–2.2 g/kg) split over 4–5 feedings; include 25–40 g per meal/snack.

Below is a 12‑week, low‑impact strength program designed to rebuild lower‑body strength and control while respecting a healing right medial meniscus. It progresses from capacity and motor control to heavier strength and ski‑specific demands without jumping or deep knee flexion under load. It uses a full gym, 3 strength sessions per week plus optional conditioning and mobility. All lower‑body loaded work stays within pain‑free range, avoids end‑range knee flexion under load, and uses controlled tempos. Progress only if pain remains ≤2/10 during and after, no swelling next day.

Key guardrails
- No jumping, running, or plyometrics.
- Avoid deep knee flexion under load (generally keep loaded knee angles ~0–70°, possibly up to ~80–90° if totally symptom‑free and surgeon clears).
- Prioritize bilateral patterns early; introduce unilateral with careful ROM and support.
- Pain or swelling = reduce ROM, load, tempo, or volume next session.

Global weekly structure
- 3 strength sessions/week (A, B, C), 45–70 minutes.
- 2–3 low‑impact conditioning sessions/week (bike/elliptical/rowing; separate days or after strength).
- Daily knee care: mobility, soft tissue, and isometrics as prescribed.
- Tempo guidance: most lower‑body lifts start 3–1–2 (eccentric–pause–concentric) to limit joint stress and improve control.

Phase overview
- Phase 1 (Weeks 1–3): Foundation and capacity. Isometrics, controlled ROM, core/hip strength, re‑introduce bilateral squatting pattern to tolerable depth.
- Phase 2 (Weeks 4–6): Strength building. Increase external load, introduce supported unilateral patterns, add hinge emphasis.
- Phase 3 (Weeks 7–9): Heavier strength and force tolerance. Progress to moderate loads, controlled partial ROM decel patterns, more single‑leg stability.
- Phase 4 (Weeks 10–12): Ski‑specific strength and endurance. Emphasis on quad/hip endurance in mid‑range, trunk stiffness, lateral control; maintain heavy hinge. No jumping; use quasi‑isometrics and tempo for “eccentric‑like” stimulus.

Warm‑up template (every session, 10–12 minutes)
- Tissue and mobility: 1–2 min/side calf foam roll, quad and adductor light rolling; 60–90 s knee flexion/extension heel slides or stationary bike easy spin.
- Dynamic prep: 1 set each: glute bridge x10, side‑lying clamshell x12/side, ankle rocks x10, hip airplanes supported x5/side, bodyweight box squat to comfortable height x8 with 3‑1‑2 tempo.
- Readiness isometrics: wall sit at 45–60° knee angle x 20–30 s; split‑stance isometric quad set x 15 s/side.

Conditioning (2–3x/week)
- Options: upright bike or spin bike preferred; elliptical acceptable if no symptoms; rowing if knee tolerates. Start 20–25 min Z2 (easy talk pace), progress to 30–40 min by Week 6, add 1 tempo interval day in Phases 3–4 (e.g., 3–4 x 5 min moderate with 2 min easy). No standing climbs if it aggravates knee.

- Quad sets x10 with 3–5 s squeeze; heel prop terminal knee extension x10.

Week 7
Session A

- Split‑stance Spanish squat iso (front‑back stance): 3x30–40 s/side.

Session B
- RFESS to pads: 4x5/side, heavier but controlled.
- Hip thrust: 5x5 heavier.
- Hamstring curl: 3x8 heavy.
- Lateral step‑down (2–6 in): 3x6/side, slow 3–1–2.

Session C
- Belt squat 5x4 heavy or landmine hack squat variant to box.
- Single‑leg leg press 3x8/side moderate‑heavy.
- Good morning (light–moderate): 3x6–8 or reverse hyper 3x10.
- Wall sit: 3x45 s.
- Farmer carry heavy: 4x30 m.

Week 8
- Microload increases. Introduce controlled “decel” drills without jump:
  - Altitude drops to calf raise? Not allowed due to no jumping. Instead:
  - Slow eccentric step‑downs: 3 s down, light toe tap, 1 s up, 3x6/side.

Week 9

Session A

Session B
- RFESS 4x5/side heavy‑moderate.

Session C
- Belt squat 4x4 heavy.
- Single‑leg leg press 3x10/side moderate.
- Back extension 3x12 with 2 s hold at top.

  - Banded lateral walks x12/side

Week 12

Session B

- Soreness is okay; joint pain/swelling is not. Next‑day swelling or pain >2/10: cut the provocative exercise volume by 30–50%, reduce ROM, and add an extra easy bike day.

Here’s a practical, weight-stable nutrition plan to support strength, knee health, and return to skiing. Calorie target and tracking
- Goal: Maintain current bodyweight (±0.25%/week). If he doesn’t know maintenance, start at 14–16 kcal per lb (31–35 kcal/kg) and adjust by 150–200 kcal after 10–14 days based on average scale weight.

- Carbs: 1.5–2.0 g per lb (3–4.5 g/kg) on strength days; 1.2–1.6 g per lb (2.5–3.5 g/kg) on rest/easy conditioning days. Emphasize around workouts.

- Pre‑training (60–120 min): 30–60 g carbs + 20–35 g protein; low in fat/fiber if he gets GI upset.
- During training: Water is fine for sessions <75 min. If a hard bike day ≥60 min Z3, consider 20–30 g carbs (sports drink).
- Post‑training (0–2 hours): 30–60 g carbs + 25–40 g protein. If a later meal follows soon, just fold into that meal.

Around training (specific to his plan)

Fiber and gut comfort

Alcohol
- Limit to 0–2 drinks/week. If drinking, have with a meal and avoid within 3 hours post‑training to protect recovery.

- If weight drops and training feels flat: add 25–40 g carbs to pre/post‑training and a teaspoon of olive oil at dinner (+150–200 kcal).

Cardio guardrails and engagement (all weeks)
- Stay seated, cadence 85–100 rpm for hard work; avoid standing climbs.
- If knee annoyed: raise saddle, lower resistance, switch to pool/elliptical (if symptom‑free) that day.

Recovery and mobility (condensed)
- Daily micro‑care (8–12 min): quad sets 2x10 (5 s), TKE 2x12–15 (2 s hold), heel slides 2x10, ankle pumps 1–2 min, 2 min diaphragmatic breathing.
- Mobility circuits 3–4x/week (15–20 min): ankle rocks 2x10/side + calf stretches; hip flexor 2x30–45 s/side; 90/90 rotations 2x6/side; adductor rock‑backs 2x8–10/side; figure‑4 glute 2x30–45 s/side; thoracic open‑books 2x6–8/side; modified Copenhagen iso 2x15–25 s/side.
- Post‑training cooldown (10–15 min): 5 min easy spin, light foam roll (quads/adductors/calves/glutes), heel slides 2x10–15, ankle rocks 1x10/side. Ice/elevate 10–15 min if swelling.

Nutrition (weight maintenance, performance‑oriented)
- Calories: start 14–16 kcal/lb (31–35 kcal/kg); adjust ±150–200 kcal after 10–14 days to keep weight within ±0.25%/week.
- Protein: 0.7–1.0 g/lb (1.6–2.2 g/kg) split over 4–5 feedings; include 25–40 g per meal/snack.
- Carbs: 1.5–2.0 g/lb (3–4.5 g/kg) on training days; 1.2–1.6 g/lb (2.5–3.5 g/kg) on rest days. Front‑load 60–90 g in the 2–3 hours around heavy lower and hard cardio.
- Fats: 0.3–0.45 g/lb (0.7–1.0 g/kg); flex to keep calories steady.
- Supplements (optional): creatine 3–5 g/day; fish oil 1–2 g EPA+DHA; vitamin D3 1,000–2,000 IU if needed; collagen/gelatin 10–15 g + 50–100 mg vitamin C 30–60 min pre lower‑body sessions.
- Hydration: 30–40 ml/kg/day; add 500–750 ml around training; electrolytes as needed.
- Sample training‑day structure: 3 meals + 1–2 snacks; pre 30–60 g carbs + 20–35 g protein; post 30–60 g carbs + 25–40 g protein.

Readiness and progression checkpoints
- Pain ≤2/10 during/after; no next‑day swelling. If symptoms: reduce ROM 10–15°, drop 1–2 sets of the offending lift, swap to isometrics/bike Z1–Z2 for 24–48 hours.
- By Week 12: complete wall sit 60–90 s at ~60° x 2–3; RFESS 4x5/side controlled moderate loads; box squat 3x3 @ ~80–85% of Week 10 with crisp speed; 20‑min seated threshold ride improved ~2–5%.
